beforeText: Standalone 12–22 minute explainers, guides and glossary terms. Best if you want one specific topic answered right now. | Same material, two formats — the courses go deeper and track your progress; the quick reads below are self-contained. Educational simulation only — not financial advice.
beforeTextKind: Two exact paragraph quotes, not one synthetic rendered paragraph
evidence: The actual format guide includes guides/glossary terms in a12–22-minute description, but the same live page lists featured guides at5–7 minutes. The12–22 range matches the six quick-read cards only. The adjacent same-material sentence can also imply courses are deeper versions of each quick read, although the visible course and quick-read subjects differ. Treat that latter wording as a clarity concern, not proven replicated content.
rootCause: Overbroad static format description on Learn; separate from Course duration fields in STRICT-COURSES-001/PR451.
proposedFix: Describe standalone explainers plus featured-guide/glossary links without assigning one duration range to all; explain sequenced courses versus individual-topic study without claiming identical material. Do not change any lesson text or estimates.
skepticalPass: Reading estimates need no invented Google minimum or fixed speed. The confirmed defect is inconsistent scope on the page, not that every reading estimate is wrong or an AdSense violation. No destination lesson gets review credit.

beforeTextKind: Affected label/state inventory, not one rendered sentence
evidence: Actual light-mode guest UI retains emerald400,blue400,amber400 small-text colors and white category text on light backgrounds. Eight sampled labels/states recorded at10–14px. Foreground comparisons against the root light background give approximately1.55–2.37:1 for colored samples; these are base-color comparisons, not exact every-pixel composite scores. Screenshots and background ancestry confirm low readability; category badges also use white text on80%-opaque light backgrounds. Course title hover becomes pale emerald300.
rootCause: Fixed dark-theme text utility classes lack light variants; category badge changes its background to the page background while retaining secondary white foreground.
proposedFix: Use existing page light-variant pattern with emerald/blue/amber800 for small colored labels and hover titles; light category text uses foreground. Preserve existing dark utilities, layout and data.
skepticalPass: This is a scoped readability/accessibility defect. WCAG2.2 SC1.4.3 normal-text4.5:1 is a separate accessibility benchmark, not an invented AdSense rejection reason or claim of sitewide WCAG certification. Dark inset hero uses intentional dark colors and is excluded from blanket recoloring.

evidence: Fresh actual HTTP2001200x675 Options cover viewed at source resolution. This is a visual editorial-quality risk, not proof of an incorrect payoff calculation, infringement, AI origin or an AdSense violation.
proposedFix: Change the static options track hero reference to the existing text-free futures illustration already inspected; remove only the unused import. Preserve old source asset, all course lessons/quizzes, public/draft documents, owner review and data. No image generation, pixel editing or new financial example.

Reuse of a clean existing illustration removes the textual ambiguity without inventing derivative payoff content or claiming exclusive image provenance. Verify changed images/metadata on all shared routes; no full-page review credit for those checks.

clarification: Current W3C Understanding source read in full. It allows an alternate conforming presentation in some situations (G174). An available dark theme means the light-mode findings alone do not establish whole-page formal WCAG failure. They remain confirmed light-theme readability defects;4.5:1 is the goal for these normal text labels, not an invented AdSense rule or sitewide conformance verdict.

evidence: Actual image inspection confirmed13/13 loads. Difficulty badges sit over images, so a root-background comparison alone cannot judge every loaded-image state. Bright original text can be appropriate on dark loaded art. Header/link colors and white category text remain independently confirmed light-mode problems.
refinedRemedy: Light difficulty badges receive explicit opaque pale backgrounds with dark text, ensuring readability over both loaded dark artwork and unloaded light placeholders. Dark theme stays unchanged.
falsePositiveAvoided: No assertion that original difficulty badges fail over every loaded image, and no claim of whole-page formal WCAG failure solely from optional theme.
